item.title: REDUCE YOUR RISK: Heart disease a leading killer in Louisiana
item.description: Heart disease is the leading killer of men and women in Louisiana.A Baton Rouge man was planning on making music and memories with his grandchildren in retirement, but his heart and his health had other plans.&nbsp;Watch as WBRZ's John Pastorek tells the story of a local guitarist who struggled with his heart health, and learn how you can reduce your risk.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: State senator proposes bill to name Pointe Coupee Parish highway after Ernest Gaines
item.description: BATON ROUGE - A lawmaker prefiled a bill to name a Pointe Coupee Parish roadway to honor famous author and Louisiana native Ernest Gaines.&nbsp;SB104, authored by State Sen. Caleb Kleinpeter, R-Port Allen, would designate the portion of La. Highway 1 through Pointe Coupee as the "Ernest J. Gaines Memorial Highway."The bill says La. DOTD would pay for the new signs if the measure is approved.&nbsp;The legislative session begins March 9.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: One shot at Walmart in Port Allen
item.description: PORT ALLEN - One person was shot outside of the Port Allen Walmart on Monday evening.&nbsp;The West Baton Rouge Sheriff's Office said the shooting happened outside the store along La. Highway 1 at 10 p.m.&nbsp;Deputies said one person was shot and taken to a hospital with non-life-threatening injuries.&nbsp;No more information about the shooting has been released.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments
